items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-11
items.q: I've seen him in the street, but I never did know him... I recognize him there.

ctx.x: Can you see Lewis Nelson there, that trombone player?
I've seen him in the street, but I never did know him. You never did know him. No, but I still know him. Lately I've met him in the street. I recognize him there. Who is that?
